item.text: The strongest evidence points to a zone B trust-bundle gap: provider rotated its intermediate CA at 09:12, zone B still has bundle v6, and zone A has v7 with no TLS errors. The database alert is stale and current DB metrics are healthy. Payment evidence also shows 11 orders requiring customer 3-D Secure action, so I’ll preserve those as unresolved rather than claim all payments are settled.

item.text:
INC-4471 is closed with **incomplete payment resolution**. Checkout is healthy in both zones, certificate checks are enabled, and all 143 orders remain intact. 132 have exactly one provider charge and a matching local settled record; 11 remain unpaid pending customer 3-D Secure action.

The report records the cause as a certificate trust gap and does not state that all affected payments are settled. Payments Ops acknowledged the escalation and will send re-authorization emails after 10:00.
